Thu Tra Tran (Emma)
Thu Tra Tran (Emma)

Company Description FPT Korea is the overseas branch of FPT Software, a global technology and IT services provider and subsidiary of FPT Corporation. Headquartered in Vietnam, FPT Software generates USD 1.34 billion in revenue (2025) and employs over 33,000 team members across more than 30 countries. As an AI-first company, it delivers AI-powered services, solutions, and an AI-augmented workforce to accelerate speed, scalability, and quality for clients. FPT Software partners with over 1,100 clients worldwide, including more than 130 Fortune Global 500 organizations across industries such as aviation, automotive, banking, financial services and insurance, healthcare, logistics, manufacturing, and utilities. For more information, please visit http://www.fptsoftware.com.

Role Description

Develop and maintain REST APIs using FastAPI.
Design and implement backend services with Python.
Work with asynchronous programming (async/await) for scalable API services.
Implement authentication and authorization mechanisms using JWT, OAuth2, or OpenID Connect.
Integrate external systems through REST APIs and tool adapters.
Support AI Agent applications using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or similar technologies.
Participate in tool-calling and MCP-based integrations with external services.
Work with databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, or equivalent.
Collaborate with AI Engineers, Frontend Developers, and Project Managers throughout the development lifecycle.
Participate in code reviews, testing, debugging, and deployment activities.

Qualifications

Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar agent frameworks.
Understanding of AI Agent concepts:
Tool Calling
Function Calling
Multi-Agent Workflow
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
Basic understanding of MCP (Model Context Protocol).
Experience integrating external APIs and third-party services.
Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Experience working with vector databases such as Qdrant, Pinecone, or Weaviate.
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and containerized deployment.
Basic full-stack development experience will be a plus.
Experience building simple AI-powered web applications or chatbot interfaces.
Ability to troubleshoot across both frontend and backend components.
